units.canvasMiB: Logical RGBA8 canvas bitmaps, including every DOM mirror; excludes GL input textures, drawing buffers, driver copies, decoded media and managed image caches
units.outputTextureMiB: Additional logical RGBA8 FBO output textures in GPU prototype; not VRAM residency
units.processPrivateMiB: Electron process private bytes sampled before/after, not GPU VRAM or peak memory
units.outputFps: Minimum publication rate among terminal shaders, not unique source/video frames
units.sourceCapturesPerSecond: Total captures across all stages, not per-source freshness
units.taskMs: CDP renderer task duration delta; trace times are inclusive and may overlap
